description: This file defines the SearchThrowableHandler class within the SuiteCRM\Search\UI namespace. It handles exceptions and errors encountered during the search process, displaying user-friendly messages or detailed debug pages depending on the environment configuration.

classes.name: SearchThrowableHandler
classes.description: Handles exceptions or errors during search operations, providing user-friendly or detailed error displays depending on settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the thrown exception/error and the associated search query.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process the exception/error, logging details, and displaying appropriate messages.

methods.name: getFriendlyMessage
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly message based on the type of exception.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Displays a detailed exception page with debugging information if in developer mode.

methods.name: getSearchWrapperStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the status information of the SearchWrapper for debugging purposes.

methods.name: printFriendlyMessage
methods.description: Outputs a simple error message to the user.
